rules.trigger_condition: FEED package review > 30 days overdue with > 20 open comments
rules.recommended_action: Escalate to Engineering Manager; schedule accelerated review session with owner; evaluate FEED-to-detailed engineering overlap

rules.trigger_condition: P&ID issue rate exceeds target by > 25% for two consecutive weeks
rules.recommended_action: Investigate root cause with discipline leads; rebalance drafting resources; review P&ID completeness against line list

rules.trigger_condition: HAZOP close-out < 80% within 4 weeks of completion meeting
rules.recommended_action: Issue HAZOP action tracking report to Project Director; assign owners to overdue actions; schedule weekly close-out sprint

rules.trigger_condition: IFC drawing release backlog > 50 drawings past scheduled issue date
rules.recommended_action: Audit drawing register vs. schedule; surge-allocate to drafting team; revisit IFC priority sequence with construction

rules.trigger_condition: 3D model review not started by scheduled milestone date
rules.recommended_action: Confirm model freeze date with discipline leads; assign model review coordinator; schedule inter-discipline clash detection session

rules.trigger_condition: Design change notices accumulating at > 10 per week with no disposition within 14 days
rules.recommended_action: Conduct change impact triage with Engineering Manager; enforce 14-day disposition SLA; escalate unresolved changes to Change Control Board

rules.trigger_condition: Long-lead equipment purchase order not placed within 2 weeks of approved award recommendation date
rules.recommended_action: Expedite commercial close-out with vendor; escalate to Procurement Director; evaluate price escalation risk and re-forecast delivery

rules.trigger_condition: Vendor Document Review (VDR) cycle exceeds 45 days from submission to approval
rules.recommended_action: Flag to Engineering and Procurement leads; prioritise vendor submittals; implement 15-day turnaround SLA with automatic escalation

rules.trigger_condition: FAT schedule slippage > 2 weeks from baseline with no recovery plan
rules.recommended_action: Request FAT recovery schedule from vendor; assign FAT observer; evaluate waiver of factory testing scope if risk-assessed

rules.trigger_condition: L/C or payment milestone > 10 days overdue without documented vendor agreement
rules.recommended_action: Verify vendor invoice completeness; contact Trade Finance team; issue payment status memo to Project Controls

rules.trigger_condition: Expediting report overdue by > 5 working days for two consecutive reporting cycles
rules.recommended_action: Follow up with expeditor; send reminder to Supply Chain Manager; consider rotating expediting resource

rules.trigger_condition: Logistics booking not confirmed within 7 days of shipping window opening
rules.recommended_action: Contact logistics broker/forwarder; identify alternate shipping routes; escalate to Logistics Manager for premium freight approval

rules.trigger_condition: Critical path activity delay > 2 weeks with no approved recovery schedule
rules.recommended_action: Immediately convene recovery planning session with Construction Manager; re-sequence remaining scope; evaluate overtime or shift work

rules.trigger_condition: S-curve actual progress deviation > -10% from planned for three consecutive weeks
rules.recommended_action: Perform earned value analysis; identify productivity gaps by work package; re-forecast remaining durations and adjust manpower ramp

rules.trigger_condition: Lookahead plan schedule coverage < 90% for next 3-week window
rules.recommended_action: Request updated lookahead from site planning team; verify constraint removal (materials, drawings, permits); hold weekly plan review with superintendents

rules.trigger_condition: SIMOPS conflicts identified but not resolved within 48 hours of identification
rules.recommended_action: Schedule SIMOPS coordination meeting with all affected trades; update construction sequence plan; issue conflict resolution memo

rules.trigger_condition: Site productivity below baseline by > 15% for any work package in two consecutive reporting periods
rules.recommended_action: Investigate root cause (materials, access, supervision, weather); implement productivity improvement plan; adjust crew composition if needed

rules.trigger_condition: Civil/structural handover to mechanical delayed by > 2 weeks with no revised date
rules.recommended_action: Conduct area readiness walkdown with civil and mechanical leads; agree revised handover schedule; escalate to Project Manager if re-sequencing required

rules.trigger_condition: Lost Time Incident Rate (LTIR) exceeds project target by > 50%
rules.recommended_action: Stand down affected area; convene HSE incident review board; implement immediate corrective and preventive action plan; notify client and regulatory bodies

rules.trigger_condition: Permit to Work (PTW) compliance audit failure rate > 15% in any single month
rules.recommended_action: Re-train all supervisors on PTW procedure; re-issue permits with area-specific signoffs; increase spot-check frequency to daily

rules.trigger_condition: Confined space entry detected without valid permit or gas test certificate
rules.recommended_action: Immediately evacuate all personnel from confined space; issue stop-work order; conduct incident investigation; discipline responsible supervisor

rules.trigger_condition: Hot work observed within 15 m of flammable storage without fire watch
rules.recommended_action: Stop hot work immediately; re-locate operation to designated safe area; verify fire suppression equipment; re-issue hot work permit with strict conditions

rules.trigger_condition: Scheduled emergency response drill > 30 days overdue against quarterly plan
rules.recommended_action: Schedule make-up drill within 7 days; verify drill scenarios cover current risk profile; update drill tracker in HSE dashboard

rules.trigger_condition: Non-Conformance Report (NCR) backlog exceeds 20 open items for more than 2 weeks
rules.recommended_action: Assign NCR disposition responsibility to discipline leads; schedule weekly NCR review board; escalate repeat findings to Quality Manager

rules.trigger_condition: Weld NDT rejection rate exceeds 5% in any rolling monthly window
rules.recommended_action: Review welder qualifications and procedure qualifications; increase supervision of welding operations; conduct retraining if consistent pattern found

rules.trigger_condition: Hydrotest pack documentation incomplete > 5 working days before scheduled test date
rules.recommended_action: Expedite submission of missing documents (weld maps, NDT reports, isometrics, pressure test procedure); delay test date if documentation not approved

rules.trigger_condition: Punch list items exceed 100 in any single system or area
rules.recommended_action: Segment punch list by trade; assign target close-out dates per contractor; conduct weekly punch list walkdowns with emphasis on safety-critical items

rules.trigger_condition: ITP witness or hold point not signed off by client or third party within 5 working days of completion
rules.recommended_action: Contact client/third-party inspector directly; reschedule witness; escalate to Quality Manager if pattern persists; document as risk

rules.trigger_condition: Pre-commissioning plan not started at least 8 weeks before scheduled mechanical completion date
rules.recommended_action: Appoint Commissioning Manager if not assigned; fast-track pre-commissioning plan development; identify lead-time items for flushing and chemicals

rules.trigger_condition: Mechanical Completion System (MCS) documentation < 50% complete within 4 weeks of planned turnover date
rules.recommended_action: Assign document controllers per system; populate MCS dossiers with available records; accelerate turnover walkdown schedule

rules.trigger_condition: Loop check backlog > 30% of total loops within 6 weeks of mechanical completion
rules.recommended_action: Increase commissioning technicians on loop checking; prioritise safety-critical and interlock loops; extend shift pattern if required

rules.trigger_condition: Flushing and cleaning procedure not approved within 4 weeks of scheduled start date
rules.recommended_action: Expedite procedure review cycle with client; check chemical procurement lead times; consider parallel flushing for separate systems

rules.trigger_condition: Performance test procedure not submitted to client 12 weeks before planned initial operation date
rules.recommended_action: Draft procedure using manufacturer commissioning manuals; review with process engineer; submit for client approval as priority deliverable

rules.trigger_condition: Earned Value Schedule Variance (SV) < -15% for two consecutive reporting periods
rules.recommended_action: Perform detailed earned value analysis by work package; identify root causes of schedule lag; develop and approve recovery plan with contingency draw

rules.trigger_condition: Estimate-at-completion (EAC) trending > 10% over awarded budget value
rules.recommended_action: Review cost forecast assumptions with Project Controls Manager; identify overrun drivers; prepare change order or contingency release request

rules.trigger_condition: Change order approval cycle exceeds 30 days from submission to signed approval
rules.recommended_action: Trace change order through approval chain; identify bottleneck approver; escalate to Project Director; enforce 21-day SLA for all change orders

rules.trigger_condition: Monthly progress report not submitted within 5 working days of month-end for two consecutive months
rules.recommended_action: Reinforce reporting deadlines with all discipline leads; pre-populate standard sections; escalate to Project Controls Manager for workflow improvement

rules.trigger_condition: Claims reserve value increasing quarter-over-quarter by > 20% with no settlement progress
rules.recommended_action: Review claims basis with Commercial Manager; engage legal counsel if meritorious; pursue early settlement or alternative dispute resolution

rules.trigger_condition: Subcontractor payment > 60 days overdue against contract milestone schedule
rules.recommended_action: Verify certified progress against application; process urgent payment; contact subcontractor to confirm receipt; review cash flow contingency allocation

rules.trigger_condition: Change order log discrepancy detected between PMIS and contract administrator records exceeding 5 unmatched items
rules.recommended_action: Reconcile change order logs from both sources; identify root cause of discrepancy; implement single-source of truth protocol for all COs
